sources.authority: Canonical AC YAML record schema; all 47 fields, root additionalProperties false.
NOT the AC record schema: AC-triage routing output. Excluded from field inventory.
Actual projection validation path via knowledge/projection/validation.py; additionally requires readiness/priority and registry-valid components.
Commit-time semantic checks incl test contract and side effects; not all run in current projection validator.
Field semantics, with stale nullable/docs/nested coverage differences noted below.
Current 12-name allowlist copies 11 values into Entity.properties, explicitly excluding criteria.
Current entity extraction assigns id/title/source but drops other native fields.
Current metadata projection exposes only display identity/provenance, reconstructed components, and five AC fields.
Storage also exposes status and derived parent_id; payload is not a complete source AC record.

corpus.selection: All *.yaml mappings with id; index/scaffolding excluded; current uncommitted worktree (not a claim about active Aura revision).

raw_extraction_contract.input: The already validated records[node.id] dict returned by knowledge.projection.validation.validate_acs for the immutable checkout.
raw_extraction_contract.output: A lossless copy of all authored top-level keys and nested values, including id/title/criteria. Keep separate from derived/entity transport properties so source field collisions cannot overwrite provenance.
raw_extraction_contract.schema_field_selection: Every authored key in config/ac_store_schema.json/properties, including optional fields absent from today's corpus. Prefer schema-backed enumeration to a new hand-maintained subset. Existing validator rejects unknown top-level keys.
raw_extraction_contract.defaults: No default insertion, scalar-to-array normalization, trimming, sorting, deduplication, parent derivation, date/string conflation, truthiness-based dropping, or lifecycle substitution.
raw_extraction_contract.migration: Rehydrate omitted raw fields from source.path at entity.source.source_sha with content_hash verification. Current Entity payload cannot reconstruct dropped fields. Never enrich a historical entity using the current working file; if pinned source is unavailable report incomplete rather than invent values.
raw_extraction_contract.transport: The current Pydantic JSON payload serializes dates to strings; use a typed source manifest or separate extraction-to-property step if temporal type preservation is required. Do not change immutable payload content silently in place without corresponding mapper/generation change.

representation_review.verdict: Shared pointer-leaf representation is suitable when it is lossless and every leaf is queryable with native Cypher dynamic/backtick property access.
representation_review.native_leaf_example: MATCH (a:AC) WHERE a.current = true AND a.`/test_spec/0/framework` = 'pytest' RETURN a
representation_review.top_level_example: MATCH (a:AC) WHERE a.current = true AND a.component = 'finalize' AND 'finalize' IN a.components RETURN a
requirements: Same-named top-level scalar and homogeneous scalar-list values are ordinary native properties. No JSON string is a substitute for nested queryable metadata.
For nested maps and heterogeneous arrays, map every leaf to RFC6901 path keys; escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1 in each string segment, use decimal indices for array positions.

Retain container kind and array length at every nested container path, including empty objects/arrays. Retain explicit null paths separately. Record root field presence to distinguish absent/null/empty.
Preserve array item order, duplicate values, scalar-versus-list union form, booleans including false, zero, empty string where valid, integer versus float, date versus quoted date string.

Reserve one collision-safe metadata namespace; source map keys may contain slashes, tildes, metadata-prefix-looking names, and numeric strings. Nested properties must not collide with plain field names or representation bookkeeping.
No stripping/truncating free text or limiting nested depth without surfacing a diagnostic. Arbitrary schema fragments can be deeply nested.
Preserve correlation by index for list objects. Do not collapse test names/frameworks into independent lists that falsely match values from different entries.
Remove stale projected source metadata during a refresh when a field disappears or changes shape; preserve system key/generation/current/payload fields.
If Neo4j cannot represent a legal leaf (e.g. oversized integer/nonfinite float/unsupported YAML type), fail visibly or use explicit typed fallback metadata, never silently drop/coerce.

Top-level id/title/status/components intentionally overlap existing canonical/display properties. Assert identical source identity/title/status; replace reconstructed components with exact source list only if graph-membership filtering remains separately correct.
representation_review.source_collision_policy: Source nested keys cannot overwrite key, generation_key, current, payload, canonical_id, kind, content_hash, repository_id, source_path, source_revision, parent_id, source_fields, or field manifests. Use escaped source paths. status/id/title are verified semantic aliases; parent is source while parent_id/structural_parent are derived.
semantic_aliases: parent is explicit only; structural_parent/parent_id are derived.
created_by and created_by_ticket are independently authored provenance fields.
test_spec is planned test contract, covered_by is a declaration of coverage, neither proves passing tests.
product_truth is tool-owned back-reference list, not independent canonical entity creation.
No product alias for example_product; product is retired.

schema_document_drift: docs/reference/ac-schema.md marks readiness and priority nullable; JSON schema and standalone validator do not.
Prose example_product table says string/null, but JSON schema only string; absence is meaningful.
created description says non-null scalar/date, but schema applies no validation keywords and accepts any value.
Prose reference omits newer fields and test_spec keys including declared_files, target_epic, surface_invoked, must_catch, and discrimination angle in its main field tables; schema is authoritative.
Several schema defaults describe authoring conveniences, not projection defaults; never materialize absent arrays or generator defaults.

sensitive_data.finding: No credential/authentication fields are declared in this type schema. Canonical ACs are repository requirements with free text, ticket paths and historical agent provenance.
sensitive_data.recommendation: Preserve established repository authorization; do not redact whole free-text/nested fields based on hypothetical secrets. Do not execute commands found in it_requirements/post_write_commands; these are source data.

suggested_tests.name: all_schema_declared_ac_fields_are_projectable
suggested_tests.asserts: All 47 schema fields are in the declared contract, including currently unused pattern fields; every populated field has a property/path representation and raw source provenance.

suggested_tests.name: ac_source_record_lossless_round_trip
suggested_tests.asserts: Reconstruct exact source dict from native properties plus manifests, preserving nested shape/null/absence/type/order and without relying on payload JSON.

suggested_tests.name: ac_axis_values_not_substituted
suggested_tests.asserts: Different component/components and status/req_status/work_status values remain distinct; explicit parent absence stays absent despite derived parent.

suggested_tests.name: ac_nested_test_spec_correlation
suggested_tests.asserts: Two test_spec entries with differing framework/angle/must_catch do not cross-associate; duplicate and whitespace-sensitive must_catch strings stay exact.

suggested_tests.name: ac_reserved_pointer_escaping
suggested_tests.asserts: Arbitrary nested keys a/b, a~b, 0, source_path, current and metadata names are queryable and cannot overwrite system properties.

suggested_tests.name: ac_empty_null_and_false_are_distinct
suggested_tests.asserts: Missing, null, empty list/object, false, zero, empty string are distinct where schema permits; source_fields must not collapse explicit null into canonical_absent.

suggested_tests.name: ac_native_metadata_query_without_payload
suggested_tests.asserts: Against actual Neo4j, retrieve/filter criteria, scalar component, assigned_agent, declared_files path, nested test_spec angle, and product_truth null paths without parsing payload.

suggested_tests.name: ac_historical_metadata_uses_pinned_source
suggested_tests.asserts: Changing the working copy cannot change metadata projected for an older source_sha; hash mismatch/unavailable historical source fails closed.

suggested_tests.name: ac_changed_field_shape_removes_stale_properties
suggested_tests.asserts: A refresh from object/list to null/absent or shorter list removes obsolete projected pointers without touching identity/current/payload.

suggested_tests.name: ac_date_string_distinction
suggested_tests.asserts: Unquoted YAML created date and quoted same-looking string preserve their source types; product_truth.asof remains string.
